name: Kohikan Shimura-sakaue
nameJa: 珈琲館 志村坂上店
address: 3-20-1 Maenocho, Food Square Kasumi B1F, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
description: A relaxed full-service coffee-house branch inside a supermarket complex that provides free Wi-Fi and customer power outlets, making it a comfortable spot for focused work.

name: Komeda Coffee Tobu-Shimoakatsuka
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 東武下赤塚駅店
description: A spacious cafe-chain branch near Narimasu offering the free Komeda Wi-Fi network and power outlets, with roomy booth seating well suited to laptop sessions.

name: Starbucks Coffee EQUiA Narimasu
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー エキア成増店
description: A station-building Starbucks with confirmed free Wi-Fi and long opening hours, though outlet availability could not be verified so power is left unconfirmed.

name: Cafe di Espresso Kohikan Narimasu
nameJa: カフェ・ド・エスプレッソ 珈琲館 成増店
description: A traditional-style coffee house near Narimasu station with power outlets available, though its Wi-Fi is carrier-operator (au/SoftBank) rather than a free customer network.

name: Doutor Coffee Shop Narimasu 2-chome
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 成増2丁目店
description: An inexpensive Doutor branch by Narimasu station that has usable power outlets, but its listed Wi-Fi is carrier-operator (docomo/au) so you may need your own connection.

name: Doutor Coffee Shop Shimura-sakaue
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 志村坂上店
description: A budget Doutor near Shimura-sakaue offering power outlets for charging, with only carrier-operator Wi-Fi (docomo/au) rather than free in-store Wi-Fi.

name: Kohikan Oyama
address: 24-10 Oyama-Higashicho, House Itabashi Oyama 1F, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
description: A coffee house by Oyama station that offers free Wi-Fi but, per the source, no customer power outlets, so it suits short sessions rather than long laptop work.
